body.message:
Please note that the previous rental amount was for a 1-month stay, which has now been completed.

Kindly be informed that the monthly rates vary depending on the current market situation and availability. If you would like to extend your stay, the rate for the next month will be AED 13,200 for 30 nights.

Unfortunately, we are unable to offer the same rate as your previous booking, as the rates are subject to market changes.

If you would like to proceed with the extension, please let us know so we can arrange the necessary details accordingly.
